decision: Recommend a frozen promotion gate centered on hidden must-cover/harmful-omission rubrics, downstream agent tasks and time-to-evidence, exact AB/BA mirrored judges calibrated to humans, three generator repeats, full observed-cost parity, and one-change branch ablations.
why: Repository evidence shows holistic small-N judging confounded by source lottery and hidden read amplification; external primary studies show order, verbosity, and self-preference effects.
